sentences.cn_text: 先是两小时，现在是三小时——这就是当局建议人们为搭乘国内航班应提前抵达的时间，至少在一些安检队伍日益庞大的美国主要机场是如此。
sentences.en_text: First two hours, now three hours — this is how far in advance authorities are recommending people show up to catch a domestic flight, at least at some major U.S. airports with increasingly massive security lines.

sentences.cn_text: 美国人愿意容忍耗时的安检程序，以换取更高的安全保障。
sentences.en_text: Americans are willing to tolerate time-consuming security procedures in return for increased safety.

sentences.cn_text: 埃及航空804航班的坠毁——该航班可能是被恐怖分子在地中海上空击落的——再次以悲剧形式提醒人们这样做的原因。
sentences.en_text: The crash of EgyptAir Flight 804, which terrorists may have downed over the Mediterranean Sea, provides another tragic reminder of why.

sentences.cn_text: 但对航空旅客要求过多或提供的安全保障过少，都会削弱公众对这一流程的支持。
sentences.en_text: But demanding too much of air travelers or providing too little security in return undermines public support for the process.

sentences.cn_text: 这种削弱是应该的：时间的浪费不仅拖累了美国人的经济和私人生活，更令人恼火。
sentences.en_text: And it should: Wasted time is a drag on Americans’ economic and private lives, not to mention infuriating.

sentences.cn_text: 去年，运输安全管理局（TSA）在一次秘密检查中发现,卧底调查人员几乎每次尝试都能将武器——无论真假——偷偷带过机场安检。
sentences.en_text: Last year, the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) found in a secret check that undercover investigators were able to sneak weapons — both fake and real — past airport security nearly every time they tried.

sentences.cn_text: 自那以后实施的加强安检措施，加上经济改善和低油价导致的航空旅行增长，已使芝加哥奥黑尔国际机场等主要机场出现长时间等待。
sentences.en_text: Enhanced security measures since then, combined with a rise in airline travel due to the improving economy and low oil prices, have resulted in long waits at major airports such as Chicago’s O’Hare International.

sentences.cn_text: 航空安检的有效性究竟提高了多少目前尚不清楚——但排队现象却显而易见。
sentences.en_text: It is not yet clear how much more effective airline security has become — but the lines are obvious.

sentences.cn_text: 问题的一部分在于政府未能预见航空旅行的急剧增长，因此运输安全管理局目前正急于让新的安检人员上岗。
sentences.en_text: Part of the issue is that the government did not anticipate the steep increase in airline travel, so the TSA is now rushing to get new screeners on the line.

sentences.cn_text: 问题的另一部分在于机场用于安检通道的空间有限。
sentences.en_text: Part of the issue is that airports have only so much room for screening lanes.

sentences.cn_text: 另一个因素可能是更多人试图将随身行李塞得过满以避免托运行李费用，尽管航空公司对此强烈否认。
sentences.en_text: Another factor may be that more people are trying to overpack their carry-on bags to avoid checked-baggage fees, though the airlines strongly dispute this.

sentences.cn_text: 运输安全管理局可以采取一项既不需要改造机场也不需要急于招聘的措施：让更多人加入预检计划。
sentences.en_text: There is one step the TSA could take that would not require remodeling airports or rushing to hire: Enroll more people in the PreCheck program.

sentences.cn_text: 预检计划本应是旅客和运输安全管理局的双赢方案。
sentences.en_text: PreCheck is supposed to be a win-win for travelers and the TSA.

sentences.cn_text: 通过背景审查的乘客有资格使用快速安检通道。
sentences.en_text: Passengers who pass a background check are eligible to use expedited screening lanes.

sentences.cn_text: 这使运输安全管理局能够将注意力集中在风险较高的旅客身上，从而为所有相关人员节省时间。
sentences.en_text: This allows the TSA to focus on travelers who are higher risk, saving time for everyone involved.

sentences.cn_text: 运输安全管理局希望在预检计划中登记2500万人。
sentences.en_text: The TSA wants to enroll 25 million people in PreCheck.

sentences.cn_text: 该计划远未达到这一目标，一个重要原因是价格冲击：乘客必须每五年支付85美元来处理其背景审查。
sentences.en_text: It has not gotten anywhere close to that, and one big reason is sticker shock: Passengers must pay $85 every five years to process their background checks.

sentences.cn_text: 从一开始，这个价格就是预检计划的致命缺陷。
sentences.en_text: Since the beginning, this price tag has been PreCheck’s fatal flaw.

sentences.cn_text: 即将进行的改革可能会将价格降至更合理的水平。
sentences.en_text: Upcoming reforms might bring the price to a more reasonable level.

sentences.cn_text: 但国会应考虑直接介入此事，通过帮助资助预检登记或以其他方式降低成本来实现这一目标。
sentences.en_text: But Congress should look into doing so directly, by helping to finance PreCheck enrollment or to cut costs in other ways.

sentences.cn_text: 运输安全管理局不能在大多数旅行公众在不必要的队伍中受苦的同时，继续将资源转移到使用率不足的预检通道。
sentences.en_text: The TSA cannot continue diverting resources into underused PreCheck lanes while most of the traveling public suffers in unnecessary lines.

sentences.cn_text: 早就该让这个计划发挥作用了。
sentences.en_text: It is long past time to make the program work.
